column1: # Quoted spans in translation/en_*.tsv and how the encoder draws them (tools/textenc.py reads this file).
# class: bold = a name or term: drawn in the bold font, quote marks removed, punctuation at the end of the span
#        (. , ! ? ; :) moves outside the bold run and stays regular weight.
#        speech = quoted speech or a clause: regular weight, quote marks kept.
#        bold? / speech? = doubtful; the encoder follows the word before the '?'. Flip a span by editing its class.
# span = the text between the straight quotes exactly as in the TSV (markup such as | included).
# A quoted span missing from this file falls back to an automatic rule and the build logs a warning.

column2: an even worse demon beast is coming.
I'm heading for the Sea Castle.
Looks like Yukishiro's in the Sea Castle.
Mountain Village, where water is plentiful
I am... ...Kubira... ...slain... ▼| ...something I wanted to tell you... ▼| ......waited here.
I am Kubira, one of the Twelve Heavenly Generals, slain by the Susano Oh of the Mountain. ▼| There was something I wanted to tell you, so I lingered on as a spirit and waited here.
I give you the Helm of Dreams, which was sealed away by the power of the Susano Oh of the Mountain.
Sweep away the evil that swirls through this world. ▼| That is your destiny.
I don't really know|what's going on, but...
I can see a town! Let's go there.
The Beast Demon King's castle is dangerous.
No one would blame you for that choice.
What courage you have. At least take this shield.
I'm the one who requested an audience with the Beast Demon King earlier.
So you're the human who's been defying Lord Beast Demon King! I'll eat you alive!!
I wonder how Dad is doing...
That's enough, old man! Lord Beast Demon King has taken your voice!
Lord Demon King... Lord Demon King...
This is holy ground. You must not enter.
Now take up the helm and awaken to your mission.
Go out upon the wide sea and defeat Susano Oh.
Now that you have awakened to your mission, there is no need to waver.
Use the ship however you like.
Took you this long to notice, huh?
You see... ▼|the truth is, I'm a spy sent by Lord Susano Oh to lure you into a trap!
This room will be your grave!
Hurry up and bring that key!
Instead of coming over here, hurry up and help me!
Over here! At the top of the stairs!
Man... oh! Hey, you there, buddy!
You came to beat Susano Oh, right?
Then have I got a deal for you.
There's a sailor trapped in the floor on the first level.
Word is that guy met Susano Oh.
Get me out of here, and I'll tell you how to rescue the sailor.
What I need you to do is simple.
Go to the room in the southwest corner and just step on the floor tile with a pattern on it.
It's the odd-looking tile in that room's northeast corner!
I'm counting on you. You're my only hope.
I was a bandit in the Tabito Gang.
Back then, I was doing pretty well...
But then we got crushed by some monster of a guy called Susa, and it was all downhill from there.
Well, whatever... ▼| Now, about how to rescue that guy...
Go back downstairs. To the west, you'll find a staircase that leads to a pool.
Climb it and go to the right corner. There's a hidden room there.
You'll find a key in it.
H-hey, you! I'm a sailor, and I'm trapped in this floor!
Without this jewel, you can't get in!
You've come to defeat Susano Oh, haven't you?
Let me tell you how to reach him.
First, go up to the second floor and stand in front of the door on the south side.
Open the door with telepathy, and take what they call the 'Sealing Orb.'
You'll be able to use telepathy once you're in front of the door.
Take the orb downstairs. It will disable the traps, so you can reach Susano Oh!
As long as Lord Susano Oh of the Sea reigns, you shall not pass! Die!
the PK Bomb is in the ruins
Heh heh heh! Susa! We've finally caught you.
Susa, I think I can open the door.
Sightseeing flights are suspended. Anyone who wants to fly, come to the island.
